senses.gloss: pr. n. pl. (Ἄρκη, Ἄρκαι) Arca, also called A. Cæsarea, Cæs. Libani, at the North-Western foot of Mount Lebanon.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 37:6">Gen. R. s. 37</cite> (interpreting <he>הערקי</he> <cite ref="Genesis 10:17">Gen. X, 17</cite>) <he>א׳ דליבנן</he> (some ed. <he>ארקס</he>). [Cmp. <he>ערקת לבנה</he> <cite ref="Bekhorot 57b">Bekh. 57ᵇ</cite>, v. Neub. Géogr. p. 33; 299.]
